LESSON: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.5: Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creative Writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we write?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. learn from oral and reading activities to enrich their written words
2. apply knowledge of writing organizer to write a coherent story
3. apply knowledge of writing conventions to aid meaning and presentation Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: Learners participate in developing and writing creative sentences and stories in pairs, groups and whole class. 145 Links to PCIs : Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas stories with other children in the community

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. learn from oral and reading activities to enrich their written words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to learn from oral and reading activities to enrich their written words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. apply knowledge of writing organizer to write a coherent story
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply knowledge of writing organizer to write a coherent story. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. apply knowledge of writing conventions to aid meaning and presentation Core-Competence to be developed: Communication and collaboration: Learners participate in developing and writing creative sentences and stories in pairs, groups and whole class. 145 Links to PCIs : Life skills: Skills of knowing and living with others - effective communication Links to other learning areas: all learning areas stories with other children in the community

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creative Writing.
2. Explain Creative Writing to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners create stories from 1) Why do we write? learner should be able to: pictures provided(picture spark) 2) What do we write? 3 lessons a) plan and organize ideas
4. Show that you can: learn from oral and reading activities to enrich their written words
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creative Writing. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do we write?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
